# Colosseum

> Local-first macOS app for collecting images, video, links, and text into boards with blocks and connections. Private, offline, no cloud, no account, no website.

Colosseum is an Are.na-inspired personal media library and mood board that runs entirely on your Mac. Built with Swift, SwiftUI, and SwiftData. Requires macOS 14+.

## Links

- Repository: https://github.com/paul-bokelman/colosseum
- Latest download: https://github.com/paul-bokelman/colosseum/releases/latest
- License: MIT (see LICENSE)

## Product facts

- Platforms: macOS 14+
- Architecture: local-first; SwiftData store + Application Support media folder
- Content types (blocks): image, video, link, text, Are.na channel preview
- Organization: boards, nested boards, connections, notes, tags, search
- Capture: menu bar capture for paste/URL/file; main window import
- Interop: import public Are.na channels into local boards
- Privacy: no telemetry, no sync, nothing leaves the machine

## Source map

- App entry: Sources/Colosseum/ColosseumApp.swift
- Models: Sources/Colosseum/Models/ (Board, Block, Connection, BlockKind)
- Services: Sources/Colosseum/Services/ (import, Are.na, media library, tags)
- UI: Sources/Colosseum/Views/
- Package: Package.swift
